# `isnull`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
isnull(expr)
```

Returns true if `expr` is null, or false otherwise.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `predicate_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT isnull(1);
```

Result:

```text
false
```
